<thought>Based on the ¹H NMR data (two equivalent CH₂ triplets at ~2.6–2.8 ppm, J ≈ 7.3 Hz, and a symmetric para‑substituted aromatic ring giving two sets of 2H aromatic protons), the most plausible structure is a para‑disubstituted benzene where each substituent is an ethyl group (–CH₂CH₃). This matches the observed pattern and yields the SMILES string `c1ccc(CC)cc1CC`.</thought>
<final_answer>c1ccc(CC)cc1CC</final_answer>
